s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with pruritus and skin lesions
salient_findings: Erythematous papules, crusts, and fissures on the skin
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis
Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic skin condition with pruritus and skin lesions
salient_findings: Erythematous papules, crusts, and fissures on the skin
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
key_facts: Female patient in her early 40s
No other medical history
Topical corticosteroids did not control symptoms
Physical examination revealed erythematous papules and excoriations
Scales and fissures on the lower lip
Normal blood test results including antinuclear antibodies and complement
Normal urine porphyrin analysis
Skin biopsy showed spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis
Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the upper and mid dermis
Phototest with solar simulator showed delayed erythema to UV-A

shortlist.label: Chronic actinic dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Delayed erythema to UV-A on phototest and chronic pruritus

shortlist.label: Polymorphic light eruption
shortlist.why_kept: Photodermatitis symptoms and abnormal phototest results

shortlist.label: Prurigo nodularis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic pruritus and presence of nodular lesions

shortlist.label: Atopic dermatitis
shortlist.why_kept: Erythematous papules and chronic pruritus, although lack of other atopic symptoms

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in skin biopsy, although other symptoms not typical

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of generalized pruritus, erythematous papules, and excoriations, along with the phototest results showing delayed erythema to UV-A, are consistent with chronic actinic dermatitis. The skin biopsy findings of spongiosis and erosions in the epidermis and a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate in the dermis also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Polymorphic light eruption
rejected.why: While the patient had a positive phototest, the presence of nodular lymphocyte infiltrate and the clinical presentation are more suggestive of chronic actinic dermatitis

rejected.label: Prurigo nodularis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and biopsy findings do not specifically suggest prurigo nodularis, which is characterized by nodular lesions and intense pruritus

rejected.label: Atopic dermatitis
rejected.why: The patient's lack of other medical history and the specific findings on skin biopsy and phototest make atopic dermatitis less likely

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy showed a nodular lymphocyte infiltrate, the absence of other characteristic features such as epidermotropism and atypical lymphocytes makes cutaneous T-cell lymphoma less likely
